name: Rolling liquid arps
desc: The other face of liquid keys: cascading broken-chord arpeggios rolling through a Bbmaj9-Gm9-Cm9-F9 turnaround, iter rotating the run each cycle so it phases, a pan tide, octave off-echoes and double-time at phrase ends. Motion instead of block stabs.

code.sparse: note("<[bb3 d4 f4 a4] [g3 bb3 d4 f4] [c4 eb4 g4 bb4] [f3 a3 c4 eb4]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(${len}*1.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.8).room(${room}).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note("<[bb3 d4 f4 a4 c5 a4 f4 d4] [g3 bb3 d4 f4 a4 f4 d4 bb3] [c4 eb4 g4 bb4 d5 bb4 g4 eb4] [f3 a3 c4 eb4 g4 eb4 c4 a3]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(${len}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(24)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).iter(4).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(12)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[bb3 d4 f4 a4 c5 d5 c5 a4] [g3 bb3 d4 f4 a4 c5 a4 f4] [c4 eb4 g4 bb4 d5 f5 d5 bb4] [f3 a3 c4 eb4 g4 bb4 g4 eb4]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(${len}*.8).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).delay(.25).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.32).iter(8).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.3)).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
